digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live reconciliation verification suite
propositions: The epic's headline AC—bidirectional reconciliation against a Dockerized Jira DC instance—must be proven live against a realistic copy of the real ticket store, not an empty one where 'converged' and 'works' are indistinguishable.

The store copy must be isolated (fresh git repo with no remotes, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials) and scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding and snapshot artifacts, both asserted rather than assumed.

A comprehensive DC-side mutation suite of 14 inbound and 14 outbound mutations must each round-trip against a named per-mutation oracle, with set_parent's epic case asserted directly against the transport via NotImplementedError.
Pagination must be exercised by observing the effective server page size and seeding 2*observed+1 issues in the harness, since paging is a remote-side property the store copy does not exercise.
--filter-local-ids could not match inbound creates by target key (only local_id), suppressing inbound filing; fixed by passing both identifiers so scoped writing passes establish bindings.
A snapshot differ phantom outbound update (differ._derive_provenance fallback where local_id==target==jira_key) causes unconvergeable churn, breaking idempotence across many mutation cells.
